Doggie Day Out volunteers take dogs around town for hikes and socialization; foster sleepovers give cats/dogs a break from the shelter. Volunteers 16+ (under 18 need own transport or guardian), ID, orientation required; foster requires rabies proof and county license for own pets.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.
